summary: Frontend-only mobile smoothness fix validation for KM Nishat 99 landing page. Verified Lenis is disabled on mobile (390x844) and enabled on desktop (1920x800), heavy GPU effects (backdrop-filter, grain overlay, fixed bg-attachment) are disabled on mobile via CSS media query, all landing sections render, mobile hamburger nav works with native smooth scroll and closes on link click, desktop nav links scroll via Lenis and active pill updates, and Telegram CTA hrefs are correct.

test_verifications.all_sections_render: hero/stats/mentor/learn/results/testimonials/faq/cta all present (footer uses <footer> tag, not needed in NAV_LINKS)
test_verifications.desktop_active_nav_pill_updates: learn link becomes white with pill span

critical_code_review_comments: Benign Lenis console warning about container needing non-static position appears on both mobile and desktop; not affecting functionality but worth investigating the ancestor of the Lenis-scrolled container for a 'position: relative' declaration to silence the warning.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile perf fixes validated. IS_MOBILE evaluates at module load via matchMedia; when testing, always set mobile viewport 390x844 and reload the page before assertions. Full scroll top->bottom generated zero console errors and no layout breakage.
